title: 第10章：奢侈的一顿饭
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“爸！强子说你找我。”

    “嗯，把我扶起来，整天这么躺着，感觉就跟个废人似的。”

    马建业自嘲的笑了笑，他从家里的顶梁柱一下子变成累赘，不亚于从天堂摔进泥地里，这种巨大的心理落差，没把人逼疯就已经不错了。

    “爸，我一定会把你的腿治好的。”

    马建业伸手帮马超捋了捋发丝，眼神里说不出的温柔。

    “傻小子，你已经做得很好了，爸没有怪你的意思。”

    “真的！”

    “我知道。”

    马超点了点头，扶着父亲从床上坐起来，又细心地在他后背垫了个枕头，“爸，枕头垫后面高矮行不行？”

    “有没有觉得哪里不舒服？”

    “挺好的，就这样靠着就行。”

    马建业摆了摆手，“小超，你也别来回忙活了，去找个凳子坐下歇会。”

    “好！”

    马超笑着点头，端了把椅子，稳稳坐在马建业对面。

    “这个你拿着。”

    “这是啥？”

    “你大姑下午走的时候硬塞的钱。”

    果不其然！

    马超打开手绢，里面放着1毛，2毛，5毛，1元的纸币，厚厚的一叠，最醒目的是一张大团结，全部加起来不多不少，正好56元整。

    “这么多……”

    马超将钱数了一遍又一遍。

    他可太清楚56元钱放这个年代意味着什么，顶得上城里普通工人两个月的工资，更讽刺的是，头一天马超还为父亲做手术的钱而发愁呢。

    “一共是56元钱，你数着没错吧？”

    “嗯！没错！”

    马建业叹了口气，“小超，你大姑一家也就是表面上看着风光，其实这些年她家日子过得挺不容易的。”

    “她家三个孩子要上学，要吃饭，你军哥这次又刚插队回到城里，后面要找工作，将来还要娶媳妇，这些钱是你大姑从牙缝里省出来的救命钱。”

    是啊，这些年谁家的日子都不宽裕。

    56元钱是情谊，更是掏空了大姑家的底子。
content_en:
"Dad! Qiangzi said you were looking for me."

    "Well, lift me up. I'll feel like a useless person if I lie like this all day."

    Ma Jianye laughed at himself. He suddenly went from being the mainstay of the family to being a burden, which was no less than falling from heaven into the mud. This huge psychological gap was good enough if it didn't drive people crazy.

    "Dad, I will definitely heal your leg."

    Ma Jianye stretched out his hand to smooth Ma Chao's hair, with indescribable tenderness in his eyes.

    "Silly boy, you have done a good job. Dad doesn't mean to blame you."

    "Really!"

    "I know."

    Ma Chao nodded, helped his father sit up from the bed, and carefully put a pillow on his back, "Dad, can the back of the pillow be higher or lower?"

    "Do you feel uncomfortable somewhere?"

    "It's good, just lean on it like this."

    Ma Jianye waved his hand and said, "Xiaochao, stop working back and forth and go find a stool to sit down and take a rest."

    "Okay!"

    Ma Chao nodded with a smile, picked up a chair, and sat firmly opposite Ma Jianye.

    "Take this."

    "What is this?"

    "The money your aunt forced on you when she left in the afternoon."

    Sure enough!

    Ma Chao opened the handkerchief and found a thick stack of 1-cent, 2-cent, 5-cent, and 1-yuan banknotes inside. The most eye-catching one was a big unity sheet. They all added up to exactly 56 yuan.

    "So many..."

    Ma Chao counted the money over and over again.

    He knew very well what 56 yuan meant in this era, which was equivalent to two months' salary of an ordinary worker in the city. What was even more ironic was that Ma Chao was worried about the money for his father's surgery the first day.

    "The total is 56 yuan. Did you count it correctly?"

    "Yeah! That's right!"

    Ma Jianye sighed, "Xiao Chao, your aunt's family may seem to be doing well on the surface, but in fact, her family's life has been quite difficult these years."

    "Her three children need to go to school and eat. Your brother Jun has just jumped in and returned to the city this time. He will find a job later and marry a wife in the future. This money is the life-saving money your aunt saved from her teeth."

    Yes, no one's life has been easy these years.

    56 yuan means friendship, and it empties the foundation of my aunt's family.
